purpose: Qualification contract for a future eight-domain leave-one-domain-out capability-kernel test
outcome_blindness: This contract does not reclassify existing V12.1/V13 outcomes and may not be tuned against a held-out domain.
required_descriptor_blocks: bounded heterogeneous dynamics identified without held-out task labels
information graph and physical influence graph
information pattern including observer and controller memory
actuation, delay, noise and disturbance sets
physical task set in domain units
certified inner and outer predecessor operators
required_intervention_log: initial state and innovation stream identifier
physical task margin and failure event
recovery dwell, energy, communication and computation time
leave_domain_out_rule: All abstraction maps, parameter estimators, enclosures, policies and thresholds are frozen on seven domains before the eighth descriptor or outcome is opened.
promotion_rule: A domain is OOD_KERNEL_QUALIFIED only when every descriptor block, paired intervention and held-out prediction field is evidenced. Computation alone cannot promote HIL or physical status.
